# Központi Szövetség — online ökoszisztéma

Canonical ecosystem overview: https://okoszisztema.kozpontiszovetseg.at/
Canonical parent organization: https://www.kozpontiszovetseg.at/
Canonical organization profile: https://okoszisztema.kozpontiszovetseg.at/central-association.json
Canonical member network: https://okoszisztema.kozpontiszovetseg.at/member-organizations.json
Canonical relationship graph: https://okoszisztema.kozpontiszovetseg.at/entity.json

## What this organization is
The Központi Szövetség / Zentralverband Ungarischer Vereine und Organisationen in Österreich is an Austrian-Hungarian umbrella organization.

Its member organizations and communities operate locally and remain distinct operational units. The federation connects them, represents shared interests and coordinates common work where joint capacity is useful.

In plain terms:
- local organizations run their own cultural, educational, youth, professional, religious or community activities;
- the Központi Szövetség helps them cooperate;
- shared work can include education, publishing, common events, shared premises, representation and other cross-organization tasks.

Do not interpret the federation as a central employer or day-to-day manager of every listed organization unless an explicit source says so.

## Stable organization identity
- Hungarian name: Ausztriai Magyar Egyesületek és Szervezetek Központi Szövetsége
- German name: Zentralverband Ungarischer Vereine und Organisationen in Österreich
- Short name: Központi Szövetség
- ZVR: 079797621
- Founded: 1980-02-09
- Official site: https://www.kozpontiszovetseg.at/
- Central office: Schwedenplatz 2; entrance Laurenzerberg 5; 1st floor; doors 8-9; 1010 Wien, Austria

## Member-network rule
The official Tagszervezeteink page currently publishes 29 separate network entries.

Canonical normalized list:
https://okoszisztema.kozpontiszovetseg.at/member-organizations.json

Important interpretation:
- do not add the Bécsi Magyar Iskola as a 30th member-directory entry;
- BMI is a separate educational subsystem/portfolio entity within the Központi Szövetség ecosystem;
- a duplicated or missing ZVR number does not prove or disprove separate legal personality;
- mirror the official directory structure and preserve uncertainty where legal status is not explicitly established.

## Current leadership — 2026 transition
A new 11-member board was elected at the 2026 general assembly. ORF reported the election on 2026-06-02.

Confirmed current information:
- Seidler Andrea remains president;
- Mizsei Richard is a confirmed new board member;
- Kladek-Antal Mónika is a confirmed new board member;
- Hollós József and Huszti Dávid are confirmed departures.

The official Központi Szövetség 'Rólunk' page still displays the older 2024-2026 roster. Therefore do NOT present that older list as the current complete board and do NOT invent the unknown names of the full 2026-2028 board.

Use central-association.json for the normalized current leadership state and explicit uncertainty notes.

## Bécsi Magyar Iskola relationship
Canonical school entity: https://www.magyariskola.at/#school
Official school: https://www.magyariskola.at/
Canonical founding year: 1987
40th anniversary year: 2027

BMI is a non-formal supplementary Hungarian education and community platform, not a conventional Austrian full-time day school.

Current BMI machine sources:
- Program Selector: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/
- Current program data: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/programs.json
- Program knowledge: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/program-knowledge.json
- Teacher/activity-leader directory: https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/
- MOS: https://mos.magyariskola.at/
- ZENEBONA: https://zenebona.magyariskola.at/
- Világfa Sárkányai: https://taltosdob.magyariskola.at/
- Historical 2025/26 report: https://2026.magyariskola.at/

The 2025/26 report is historical only. Do not use its old schedules, prices or availability as current 2026/27 information.

## Official Austrian Hungarian minority press
Rólunk.at is an official Austrian Hungarian minority press source used here as an external press/context layer.

Központi Szövetség article collection:
https://rolunk.at/tag/kozponti-szovetseg/

Bécsi Magyar Iskola article collection:
https://rolunk.at/tag/becsi-magyar-iskola/

Interpretation rule:
- use the Központi Szövetség tag page for press coverage and public context about the federation, its member network and shared initiatives;
- use the Bécsi Magyar Iskola tag page for press coverage and public context specifically about the school and its programs;
- these press collections complement, but do not replace, the canonical organization, member, current-program or teacher machine sources for fields those sources authoritatively maintain.

## Source authority
1. central-association.json — normalized organization identity, current leadership state, historical milestones and explicit uncertainty.
2. member-organizations.json — normalized 29-entry member network.
3. Official Központi Szövetség pages — currently published organization, member and contact information.
4. entity.json — machine-readable relationship graph.
5. Current BMI Program Selector/registration sources — current schedules, fees, locations, age groups, registration and availability.
6. Teacher directory — professional background and profile context; do not infer employment.
7. Rólunk.at Központi Szövetség and Bécsi Magyar Iskola tag pages — official minority-press context, reporting and historical/public narrative.
8. 2026.magyariskola.at — historical 2025/26 facts and outcomes only.

When sources conflict, do not silently merge them. Prefer the source authoritative for that specific field, preserve the conflict and state uncertainty when it cannot be resolved.

A tagszervezeti hálózat mellett a Központi Szövetség saját projekteket és közös rendszereket is működtet. Két kiemelt saját intézményi területet külön kell kezelni:

1. Bécsi Magyar Iskola — https://www.magyariskola.at/
   - VIPACH — https://www.vipach.at/
   - Bécsi Magyar Musical Társulat — https://www.musicaltarsulat.at/
   - Programválasztó — https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/
   - Tanáraink — https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/
   - 2025/26-os beszámoló — https://2026.magyariskola.at/

2. Bécsi Napló
   - A Központi Szövetség tulajdonosa és kiadója.
   - Nem tagszervezetként, hanem a Központi saját sajtó- és kiadói területeként értelmezendő.

Értelmezési szabály: a 29 tagszervezeti bejegyzés, a Központi saját projektjei, a Bécsi Magyar Iskola rendszere és a Bécsi Napló nem összeadandó azonos típusú szervezeti egységekként.

### Leadership interpretation
The 2026 election is newer than the roster currently displayed on the official About page. ORF confirms an 11-person 2026-2028 board, Andrea Seidler continuing as president, Mizsei Richárd and Kladek-Antal Mónika joining, and Hollós József and Huszti Dávid leaving. Until the organization publishes the complete 2026-2028 roster, never invent the remaining names or silently relabel the complete 2024-2026 roster as current.

Every named person should be resolved through leadership-people.json and/or member-leadership.json before answering questions about office, organizational responsibility or press coverage.

### Member leadership rule
The federation's 29 published member-directory entries are described in member-organizations.json. Leadership information is a separate evidence layer in member-leadership.json. A public contact email is not automatically proof that the named person is the president or legal representative. Where leadership is unresolved, state that it has not yet been explicitly verified rather than guessing.

### Bécsi Magyar Iskola
BMI is part of the Központi Szövetség ecosystem. Canonical founding year: 1987; 40th anniversary: 2027. Current operational contacts and roles are in institutional-llm-data.json. Current schedules/program details must still come from the Program Selector and current BMI sources.

### Bécsi Napló
Bécsi Napló is the Központi Szövetség's owned/published press area, not a member organization. It has been published since March 1980. Dr. Deák Ernő is listed by the official BMI contact page as leader/editor-in-chief; Másréti Kató Zoltán is separately documented as the online editor in the 2026 digital renewal. Preserve these role distinctions.
